clips.title: Can Twitch chat land DougDoug's GTA plane?
clips.setup: The transcript begins the urgent landing sequence with This is it, followed by keep looking up and instructions to stop on touchdown.
clips.payoff: The speaker says We've landed at 24.52 seconds and addresses plane chat at the end. The landing itself still needs visual verification.
clips.why_interesting: Keeps the escalating landing instructions and spoken payoff while removing twelve seconds of slower preliminary commentary. This is a story hypothesis for preview review, not a measured retention improvement.
